name: Unterramsern (Switzerland)
description: Square banner of the arms of Unterramsern: divided horizontally red and white, over all a six-petalled wild garlic flower with six discs between the petals, counterchanged.
history: Swiss municipal flags are square banners of the municipal arms, used alongside the arms without a separate adoption act.

features.role: six-petalled flower counterchanged with six discs
